name: Breakeven v3
summary: This EA is a breakeven/trailing stop utility that automatically moves the stop loss of open positions to the breakeven price once a specified profit threshold is reached. It does not open any trades itself but manages existing positions by protecting profits through breakeven and optional trailing stop functionality.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个保本/移动止损工具，当持仓利润达到指定阈值时，自动将止损移动到保本价位。它本身不开仓，而是通过保本和可选的移动止损功能来管理已有仓位、保护利润。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是保护已有利润，而非产生交易信号。入场条件方面，该EA本身不进行任何入场操作，它只是监控已有持仓的浮盈状态。出场条件方面，当持仓浮盈达到用户设定的保本触发点（Breakeven Trigger）时，EA将止损调整至开仓价加上小幅偏移量（Breakeven Offset），实现保本。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及仓位大小决策，仅管理已有仓位的止损水平。资金管理方面，该EA通过保本机制间接实现资金保护，防止盈利单变成亏损单。此外，该EA可能支持可选的移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，在保本之后继续跟随价格移动止损以锁定更多利润。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is profit protection rather than trade signal generation. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not open any trades itself; it only monitors the floating profit of existing positions. For exit conditions, when a position's floating profit reaches the user-defined breakeven trigger level, the EA moves the stop loss to the entry price plus a small offset (breakeven offset), effectively making the trade risk-free. In terms of position sizing, this EA does not make any lot size decisions as it only manages stop loss levels of existing positions. For money management, the EA indirectly protects capital through the breakeven mechanism, preventing winning trades from turning into losers. Additionally, the EA likely supports an optional trailing stop feature that continues to follow price movement after breakeven is achieved, locking in progressively more profit.

parameters.name: BreakevenTrigger
parameters.description: 触发保本的利润点数阈值
parameters.description_en: Profit points threshold to trigger breakeven

parameters.name: BreakevenOffset
parameters.description: 保本止损距开仓价的偏移点数
parameters.description_en: SL offset from entry price at breakeven in points

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0表示禁用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 means no trailing

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 移动止损每次移动的最小步长
parameters.description_en: Minimum step size for each trailing stop movement

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定管理的EA魔术号，0表示管理所有仓位
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for trade identification

parameters.name: ApplyToSymbol
parameters.description: 是否仅管理当前图表品种的仓位
parameters.description_en: Whether to manage positions of current chart symbol only

pros: 有效保护已有利润，防止盈利单变亏损单
参数灵活可调，用户可自定义保本触发点和偏移量
不自行开仓，可与任何策略EA配合使用，兼容性强
支持魔术号过滤，可精确管理特定EA的仓位
保本后可选移动止损功能，进一步锁定利润
pros_en: Effectively protects existing profits by preventing winning trades from becoming losers
Flexible and adjustable parameters allow users to customize breakeven trigger and offset levels
Does not open trades itself, making it compatible with any strategy EA for combined use
Supports magic number filtering for precise management of positions from specific EAs
Optional trailing stop after breakeven further locks in profit as price moves favorably
cons: 保本偏移过小可能因点差和佣金导致实际仍亏损
作为纯工具不产生交易信号，需要搭配其他策略EA使用
缺乏对隔夜跳空和极端行情下滑点的考虑
保本触发过早可能限制盈利空间，过晚则失去保护意义
无可视化面板，用户难以直观监控保本状态
cons_en: A very small breakeven offset may still result in a net loss after accounting for spread and commissions
As a pure utility it generates no trade signals and must be paired with another strategy EA
Does not account for overnight gaps or slippage during extreme market conditions
Setting the breakeven trigger too early limits profit potential, while too late reduces its protective value
Lacks a visual dashboard, making it difficult for users to intuitively monitor breakeven status
improvements: 增加可视化信息面板，显示各仓位的保本状态和当前浮盈
加入点差和佣金的自动计算，确保保本后真正实现净盈利
增加时间过滤功能，允许用户指定在特定时段才执行保本操作
improvements_en: Add a visual information panel displaying breakeven status and current floating profit for each position
Incorporate automatic spread and commission calculation to ensure true net profit after breakeven
Add time filter functionality allowing users to specify trading sessions during which breakeven operations are executed

risk_points: 保本偏移设置过小可能未覆盖交易成本，导致保本后止损触发仍亏损
在极端行情下止损可能因滑点而未能在预期价格执行
risk_points_en: An insufficient breakeven offset may not cover trading costs, resulting in a net loss even after breakeven is triggered
During extreme market conditions, stop loss orders may experience slippage and fail to execute at the expected price

summary_en: This EA is a breakeven/trailing stop utility that automatically moves the stop loss of open positions to the breakeven price once a specified profit threshold is reached. It does not open any trades itself but manages existing positions by protecting profits through breakeven and optional trailing stop functionality.
